_comment: Editor settings. 'basic' is meant for the future Settings screen; 'advanced' sits behind its Advanced tab. Edit the values here until then.

basic._playhead: auto: a draggable arrow on a pointer device, a fixed centre line on a touch screen. Or force 'arrow' or 'center'.

advanced._timelineHeight: Height in pixels of the waveform strip; subtitle blocks cover it without text.
advanced._snapPx: How close (in screen pixels) an edge must be to a target for the magnet to take it.
